chunks: When Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Riḍā عليه السلام married the daughter of al-Maʾmūn, he delivered the marriage sermon for himself and said:

All praise belongs to Allah, the Completer of blessings through His mercy, and the Guide to gratitude through His favor. And may Allah send blessings upon Muḥammad, the best of His creation, in whom He gathered of excellence what He had distributed among the messengers before him, and He made his inheritance belong to the one whom He singled out for his succession; and may He grant abundant peace.

And this Amīr al-Muʾminīn has married me to his daughter upon what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has ordained for Muslim women over believing men: either retention in a fair manner or release with kindness.

And I have given her as dowry what the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله gave to his wives, and that is twelve uqiyyahs and a nashsh, and the completion of the five hundred is upon me. And I have additionally bestowed upon her from my wealth one hundred thousand. You have married me to her, O Amīr al-Muʾminīn?
He said: “Yes.” He said: “I accept and am satisfied.”

key_terms.أُوقِيَّةً: a unit of weight or measure used here in specifying the dowry
key_terms.إِمْسَاكٍ بِمَعْرُوفٍ: retaining a wife in a fair and honorable manner
key_terms.الصَّدَاقِ: the marriage dower given to the bride
key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: praise and gratitude directed to Allah at the opening of the sermon
key_terms.بِخِلَافَتِهِ: his succession or vicegerency, referring to the one specially chosen for it
key_terms.تَسْرِيحٍ بِإِحْسَانٍ: releasing a wife with kindness and good conduct
key_terms.تُرَاثَهُ: the inheritance of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, mentioned as entrusted to his designated successor
key_terms.نَحَلْتُهَا: I granted or gifted her additionally from my own wealth

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Riḍā عليه السلام say in his marriage sermon when marrying al-Maʾmūn’s daughter?
ai.summary: This report records the marriage sermon of Imam Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Riḍā عليه السلام at the time of his marriage to the daughter of al-Maʾmūn. It combines praise of Allah, salawat upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, a reference to succession, and the formal legal elements of marriage including the dowry and acceptance.
